checks.name: phase_d_dsp_files_exist
command: test -f Source/DSP/TightCut.h && test -f Source/DSP/TightCut.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.h && test -f Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.cpp && test -f tests/TightCutTests.cpp && test -f tests/ChugStabilizerTests.cpp

checks.name: cmake_lists_lists_phase_d_sources
command: rg -q "TightCut\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "ChugStabilizer\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "TightCutTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "ChugStabilizerTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: tightcut_hpf_and_punch_present
command: rg -q "punch|cutoff|resonanc|Listen|listen" Source/DSP/TightCut.h Source/DSP/TightCut.cpp && rg -q "HighPass|highPass|HPF|slope" Source/DSP/TightCut.h Source/DSP/TightCut.cpp

checks.name: chug_detection_and_preserve_pick_present
command: rg -q "PreservePick|preservePick|L_low|dominance|maxReduction" Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.h Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.cpp && rg -q "attack|release|hold" Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.h Source/DSP/ChugStabilizer.cpp

checks.name: processor_wires_tightcut_and_chug
command: rg -q "TightCut" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp && rg -q "ChugStabilizer" Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
